name: com.offlineprotocol/hosted
title: Offline Protocol (hosted)
description: Offline Protocol packages, workflows and integration guides over HTTPS. Read-only.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List every Offline Protocol SDK package in the public registry with its version, supported platforms, capabilities and license.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Get one Offline Protocol package's registry entry: capabilities, peer dependencies, platform requirements, integration notes and examples.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search Offline Protocol SDK packages by name, capability or description keywords. Returns ranked matches.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search Offline Protocol capabilities, such as peer discovery or encrypted groups, and see which packages, workflows and guides provide each one.

tools.name: search_workflows
tools.description: Search Offline Protocol product workflows, such as local handoff, nearby chat, backend delivery or OfflineID sign-in, by keywords describing what you want to build.

tools.name: search_examples
tools.description: Search Offline Protocol reference example apps and integrations by keyword.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search Offline Protocol integration guides (skills) by topic. Returns matching guide names.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List every Offline Protocol product workflow with its capabilities and supported platforms.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Get one Offline Protocol workflow in full: capabilities, packages per platform, starter templates and the reference architecture (screens, services, events and data models).

name.description: Workflow name, e.g. local-handoff, backend-delivery or nearby-service

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List every Offline Protocol integration guide (skill) with the situations it covers.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Read one Offline Protocol integration guide (skill): API usage, code samples and practices for one area, such as mesh networking, identity or groups.

name.description: Skill name, e.g. mesh-networking, identity, groups

tools.name: resolve_packages
tools.description: Resolve Offline Protocol packages, or a workflow, for one platform into an exact install list: versions, required and peer dependencies, install commands and license notes.

workflow.description: Alternatively, a workflow name to resolve

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get an Offline Protocol starter template's metadata: variables, post-generation steps, notes and file list. Creates no files.

tools.name: generate_architecture
tools.description: Turn an app idea into an Offline Protocol plan: matching workflow, platform, packages, starter template and architecture documents, returned as text. Returns an error, not a guess, when the idea needs a framework the planner has no starter for (such as Flutter or native Swift) unless a platform is given.

prompt.description: What you want to build, e.g. 'Hand over equipment between field engineers and reconcile with our backend'

platform.description: Optional platform override; inferred from the prompt otherwise

tools.name: preview_scaffold
tools.description: Preview what an Offline Protocol starter would contain for an app: workflow, template, packages and file list. A dry run that writes nothing; creating the project needs the local Offline Protocol CLI.

workflow.description: Workflow name, e.g. local-handoff, backend-delivery or nearby-service

platform.description: Required when a multi-platform workflow is named without a template

enableOfflineId.description: Enable Offline ID (id-react-native) for React Native templates. Default: true for offline-social-network / offline-id-mesh-chat workflows and react-native-social; auto-switches react-native-mesh-app to react-native-social when true.

enableMesh.description: Enable mesh SDK for React Native templates (default: true for mesh workflows / mesh templates)
